class Solution:
    def distributeCandy(self, root):
        def dfs(node):
            if not node:
                return 0, 0
            left_candies, left_moves = dfs(node.left)
            right_candies, right_moves = dfs(node.right)
            total_candies = node.val + left_candies + right_candies - 1
            total_moves = abs(left_candies) + abs(right_candies) + left_moves + right_moves
            return total_candies, total_moves
        
        _, total_moves = dfs(root)
        return total_moves
